title: Chapter 844
text:
Light energy shockwaves, Mana Pyrolysis Rays, Pugilist Shockwaves, Psychic Bombs, Compressed Water Lines, and many other Beyond Grade A attacks focused on him. Han Xiao's psionic shield shattered, his mechanical suit shattered, and his body flew out uncontrollably.

His vision spun, and the galaxy seemed to have turned into meteors. It took him a lot of effort to stabilize his body and float in outer space. His body was in intense pain, and the cells in his body were being destroyed and regenerated.

Not far behind them was the enormous galactic battlefield where the fleets were fighting, and below their feet was the outline of an iron-gray planet. Sagman and the other five took back the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter and discovered that Han Xiao had tampered with it. Their expressions changed drastically.

Seeing Sagman's shocked and angry expression, Han Xiao could not help but smile despite the intense pain all over his body. He was secretly excited.

This was worth it!

The threat of the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was too great. Even if each person could only use it once in a short period of time, they could still use it six times in total. If the enemy used this killing weapon without any restraint, they would not even have a chance to fight back. Their only hope was to freeze the enemy's Ten Thousand Deity Scepter.

The core of the plan was the Spacetime Amber, which could seal the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter!

They had already been in a desperate situation earlier, so this combo was actually quite risky. First, they would pretend to surrender and take out the Evolution Cube under the enemy's supervision. Then, they would immediately launch an attack and use the Evolution Energy to force the enemy away. Two of his teammates and the Mech Legion would help to hold them back. Then, based on his experience in his previous life, he would use the amber ball to block the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, causing the enemy to be stunned for a moment to create an opening. Then, he would use the amber to block the long-range energy attack of the six people from the Arcane Church.

This was the first time the Spacetime Amber had shown its power in the universe. The enemy did not know what it was used for and was caught off guard. Only then did he have a short chance to come into contact with the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter.

Because of the Soul Connection, the production efficiency of the Spacetime Amber had increased. The size of the scepter was not large, and he had delayed it for about a minute, which was enough time to seal it!

The Ten Thousand Deity Scepter is frozen in the amber, blocking all energy. They won't be able to open the amber, so I won't be able to use this killing weapon in this battle!

Han Xiao clenched his fists in excitement. He had temporarily disabled the enemy's trump card. This battle could still be fought!

Sagman grabbed the amber ball that sealed the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. His arms glowed brightly as he pressed on the amber ball. Light energy particles gushed out from both sides of the amber ball. However, the amber ball was indestructible. The smooth and translucent surface of the amber ball was covered by the light energy particles and turned into a dazzling golden egg.

His five teammates could no longer sit still and used all their means. However, they could not break through the amber ball and could only look at the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter inside. They could see it but could not touch it.

"What is this thing made of? Why can't it be broken?" Sagman was frustrated. He then stared at Han Xiao coldly, and through Psyker's psychic voice transmission, he yelled, "B * stard, what did you do?"

There was no record of Black Star having this ability. They were not prepared. Could this be a new ability of Black Star? Or had he been hiding this trump card all along?!

Han Xiaoxin chuckled in his heart.

It was a secret that he had obtained the Spacetime Amber in the Flickering World, and he had not revealed it to anyone. Only now did he reveal this trump card for the first time.

"What did I do? The Ten Thousand Deity Scepter is so precious. I only added an extra lock on it for you. It's absolutely safe. No need to thank me. It's free! "

Han Xiao chuckled and said with a playful tone, "I wonder if you're satisfied with my sealing skills?"

This mocking tone infuriated Sagman, and his heart was burning with rage.

He had thought that Black Star and the others would not be able to resist, and victory was already in his grasp. Who would have thought that he would be tricked and fail?

Sagman gritted his teeth and tossed the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter to Ninjia after failing to break the Amber Seal.

We can't break through Black Star's means now, but at least the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter is still in our hands. When we return, we'll get the Arcane Church to figure out how to take it out. "

Ninjia had no choice but to do as he was told.

The Arcane Church had given this Universal Treasure to them because they wanted them to deal with Milizaus quickly. Now, both he and Sagman had exhausted a lot of energy from using the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, and their condition had deteriorated. However, they did not manage to kill one of the Three Pillars of the dynasty.

Not only that, the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter had been sealed by Black Star with some strange means, and they could not use this trump card for the time being. Not only could they not end the battle quickly, but their goal of intimidating EsGod was also ruined. They had gone for wool and come home shorn!

Seeing Sagman and the others put away the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, a playful smile appeared on Han Xiao's face. He knew that these people thought that the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was only temporarily unusable and felt that they could get the Arcane Church to remove the effect of the Spacetime Amber when they returned.

Heh, they still don't know the severity of the problem …

Han Xiao's lips curled up. The Spacetime Amber was the remains of the Spacetime Freezer, and its effect came from the Esper Ability to freeze spacetime. However, during the process of drifting in the universe, it had absorbed all kinds of strange cosmic radiation and had long mutated, transforming into a Space Wonder level treasure.

Most of the things that could be called Space Wonders were phenomena that could not be explained by current theories. If it was so easy to use technology to break the effect of the Spacetime Amber, there would not have been so many Beyond Grade As in his previous life dying because of it.

Such a thought flashed through Han Xiao's mind, and he quickly retracted his smile and stared at the six of them.

Although he had sealed the opponent's trump card, the suppression brought by the six Beyond Grade As still existed.

He had only completed a partial counterattack, and the battle was far from over.

The few of them faced each other outside the atmosphere, and after more than a minute, Austin, Milizaus, and Beyoni arrived.

Seeing that their temporary plan had succeeded and Han Xiao had really restricted the enemy's Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, Milizaus was overjoyed and could not help but give Han Xiao a look of approval.

You're very reliable, little brother!

Although you're the source of this crisis and caused me to be heavily injured, seeing that you saved my life, I won't be angry at you!

The number of Beyond Grade As gathered had reached a shocking ten. The energy waves emitted by the ten of them were intertwined, and it was displayed as the most dazzling high-energy reaction area on the radars of countless battleships. The number of energy waves was like countless stars exploding, constantly rising.

"Do it!"

Sagman and the others did not want to waste any more time and attacked. Han Xiao originally wanted to waste some time by talking, but seeing this, he had no choice but to counterattack.

The ten Beyond Grade As fought together and moved rapidly in the galactic battlefield, crushing all the battleships in their way and leaving behind a trail of explosions.

…

At the same time, on the mother planet of the Red Empire in the Constellation Corridor …

Ruler Uranril received an urgent report from Tarrokov and learned that the Arcane Church had launched a surprise attack on Planet Lighthouse. She was enraged.

"Arcane Church, Radiant Federation …" Uranril's face was ashen.

It was not that she did not know that these two old rivals would cause trouble when the dynasty was exploring the Flickering World. Originally, she thought that these two old rivals would at most play some dirty tricks and scheme in the dark. However, she did not expect them to be so arrogant and directly attack the dynasty's outpost in the new Star Field, wanting to kill three of the dynasty's Beyond Grade As!

Did they think that the dynasty was weak and could be bullied?

It would have been fine if it was a scheme, but the dynasty would never back down in a direct confrontation!

Uranril immediately issued dozens of orders to mobilize the dynasty's army. She did not think that there was much chance of survival on Planet Lighthouse, so she had already started preparing for her retaliation.

The dynasty's style had always been to pay blood for blood, and this was a tradition passed down from the exploration era. If one was not ruthless, one would not be able to stand firm.

Since they were already stepped on, if they did not react like a mad dog, others would think that the dynasty was weak in reality because of the Flickering World.

…

At the same time, in the Shattered Star Ring section of the player forums.

Originally, most of the players were exploring outside, but because Han Xiao was on Planet Lighthouse, a small portion of the players would occasionally return. When the battle broke out, there were players who stayed on Planet Lighthouse, and Pork Bun was one of them. He hurriedly posted on the forums.

"Something big has happened! Planet Lighthouse has been attacked by an unknown force, and it's now a mess! There are probably ten Beyond Grade A NPCs participating in this battle! "

When the news spread, the army players who were exploring outside were all stunned.

Ten Beyond Grade As, oh my god, what kind of scene is this?

How did you create such a huge piece of news in the blink of an eye?

…

In the Planet Lighthouse Universe Battlefield, the ten Beyond Grade As were fighting back and forth. Due to Austin's arrival and the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter being sealed, the Arcane Church's advantage had been greatly reduced. Although Han Xiao and the other three were in a passive position, they would not lose any time soon.

"Do you have any other plans?"

Milizaus was quite convinced by Han Xiao's idea at this time. While fighting, he communicated through the mental communication network of the few of them.

"There are still six enemies, and we're still at a disadvantage. Our goal hasn't changed, and we can only hold on until reinforcements arrive."

Han Xiao dodged a burst of light energy and controlled the Mech Legion to launch a round of focused fire, forcing Sagman back. He then continued, "The enemy also knows this and wants to end this quickly. Milizaus, although you're injured, you're still very durable. Austin has the protection of the Palace of Hidden Spells, so he won't be defeated easily. As for me, the nickname 'Indestructible Body' is not for nothing. The one most likely to be targeted by the enemy is Beyoni. He's so fragile, so he'll definitely be the first to die."

"…" Beyoni was speechless.

Damn it, I can't even refute this!

If I'm not as strong as you guys, I'm not worthy of being a Beyond Grade A!

Milizaus was helpless. "Let him stay on my back. I'll help him block a portion of the attacks. Do you have any other plans?"

"… Why don't you guys stay behind and I run?"

The three of them were confused. What's wrong with you, bro?

"Cough cough, it was a slip of the tongue." Han Xiao let out a dry cough and sighed. "There's really nothing else we can do now. This is a head-on battle, and there's no way to take any shortcuts. EsGod is still on his way. Once he arrives, the situation will be even worse for us …"

Everyone was silent. Thinking of EsGod, who had yet to appear, their hearts sank.

This time, Han Xiao made up his mind and said, "Guys, I have a request. Please help me hold on for five minutes. I won't participate in the battle during this time. Protect me well."

"What do you want to do?" Milizaus was stunned.

"I have an explosive ability that can temporarily increase my combat strength, but I can't be disturbed by the outside world during this period. I just need you guys to hold on for five minutes." Han Xiao naturally would not reveal the existence of the Promotion Mission, so he could only make up a reason.

Milizaus was helpless. I just said that the situation is serious, but you're choosing to slack off? Also, what kind of explosive ability would require a Beyond Grade A to hold on for five minutes?

"How much can it increase my combat strength?" Austin suddenly asked.

"It should be quite a bit." Han Xiao was not sure.

"Are you sure you want to do this?" Milizaus said with a deep voice. "Even if you unleash your explosive ability, it's impossible for you to become extremely strong all of a sudden. You're still a distance away from me, and this little increase in combat strength won't affect the situation much. Without you in five minutes, we'll be in even more danger. You have to know that EsGod hasn't arrived yet, so we can't suffer too much damage now …"

"It's precisely because EsGod hasn't arrived that I've decided to give it a try! If EsGod arrives, it'll be even more dangerous for you guys to hold on for five minutes. Before he arrives, try to increase our combat strength as much as possible. Maybe it'll bring about a turn for the better. "Han Xiao clenched his teeth.

That was one of the reasons. The other reason was that the advancement this time was no small matter!

Not only was it a Class Advancement, but it was also a new Race Evolution that could bring him new abilities. Furthermore, as long as he broke through this limit, he could continue to level up.

The increase would definitely be significant!

At this time, Austin suddenly said, "Alright, enter the Palace of Hidden Spells. I'll protect you for five minutes."

"… Can you do it?"

Han Xiao's tone was strange. Not long ago, Austin had even thought of retreating. Now that the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was sealed by Han Xiao and was no longer a fatal threat, Austin did not choose to retreat after hesitating. He did not expect him to take on such a difficult mission. This was completely different from the old man in his impression of him.

Could it be that unknowingly, our relationship has become so deep? Or could it be that this old man really values his reputation that much?

As if he had read Han Xiaoxin's mind, a smile appeared on Austin's tender face.

"Just when you sealed the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, I suddenly felt that letting you live might be a good thing."

Han Xiao was stunned. He thought for a while and said, "If we survive this time, I'll give you some Spacetime Amber Balls … That's what I used to block the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter."

"I was waiting for you to say that!"

Austin suddenly laughed out loud. Although he wanted to sound bold and heroic, his voice was so cute and tender.

He was indeed tempted by the Spacetime Amber and wanted to study what it was. However, this was not the only reason.

The Arcane Church's Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was defeated, which was out of his expectations. The current situation was very clear. If he stayed, they could still fight. If he ran, the dynasty's combat power would be weakened further. The chances of Black Star and the other two surviving were extremely slim. It could be said that his decision would determine the life and death of the Planet Lighthouse troops.

He had already stepped into this quagmire. If he ran away midway, both the Arcane Church and the dynasty would be dissatisfied with him. If he stayed and continued to help Black Star, he would only offend one side … More importantly, Austin wanted Han Xiao to live. He liked this guy who always gave him surprises more and more.

"Isn't it just five minutes …" Austin's eyes narrowed. "I'm not that weak!"

Han Xiao opened the secondary dimensional army box, put away the Mech Legion, and flew to the side of the Palace of Hidden Spells under the cover of his teammates. A gap appeared in the defensive formation of the Palace of Hidden Spells, allowing him to enter.

Without saying a word, he charged into the Palace of Hidden Spells, activated a mechanical army, and took out the Spacetime Amber to seal himself. After obtaining the Spacetime Amber for so long, he had already done all kinds of experiments, including sealing himself. He knew what it was like to be frozen by the Spacetime Amber.

His character's status was shown as [Frozen]. He could still move his thoughts and sense the outside world, but he could not move or release energy. He could not connect to the quantum network.

Philip followed the instructions left by Han Xiao and controlled the mechanical army to surround Han Xiao. He could use the Spacetime Amber to undo the seal at any time.

Sealing himself was a safety measure to prevent any unexpected interruptions during the escape process.

There were only three people left fighting against the six people from the Arcane Church. The pressure increased tremendously.

Sagman and the others did not know what Han Xiao was doing when they saw that he was not attacking. However, with the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter as an example, they did not dare ignore Han Xiao's abnormal actions. Instead, they turned to focus their fire on the Palace of Hidden Spells.

The Palace of Hidden Spells endured the ferocious attacks. In less than three minutes, the clock-like defensive formations protecting the Palace of Hidden Spells collapsed one after another, exploding into colorful magic fragments.

The entire palace shook non-stop, and cracks appeared. More and more magic circuits were destroyed, and many functions failed one after another.

Austin and the Forbidden Sorcerers cast spells crazily. Colorful magic runes shot into the magic formation of the Palace of Hidden Spells, and colorful magic Radiance flowed within, repairing the damaged parts of the magic formation. However, the speed of repairing was not as fast as the speed of destroying. After all, the enemy outnumbered them by twice. On the other side, Milizaus' injuries were getting more and more serious.

Although the situation was getting worse and worse, Milizaus and the other two did not give it their all. They would not be killed by the enemy within five minutes.

Austin's Palace of Hidden Spells was very sturdy. Although its durability had plummeted, it still managed to block all of the enemy's attacks.

…

At the same time, the dynasty's fleet and the Arcane Church's fleet were still fighting fiercely. High-energy light beams shot into the enemy's formation, and dazzling electric arcs appeared on the shields of the spaceships one after another.

Tarrokov had already boarded the battleship and joined the battlefield. He commanded the battle and formed a defensive line to resist the crazy attacks of the Arcane Church.

The Arcane Church's fleet outnumbered the defending army by a few times. The dark energy furnace of the enemy's disc-shaped assault ships expanded and contracted as if they were breathing, shooting out red arcs of dark energy that bombarded the giant blue psionic barrier of Planet Lighthouse's defensive line. With such a large scale of cannon fire, each round was enough to destroy the surface of dozens of planets. At this moment, the psionic barrier was exploding with dark energy.

The Arcane Church's butterfly-shaped "Glorious Sun Class" armed main battleship turned into a complete form. Hundreds of pairs of highly malleable soft alloy wings opened up, and the appearance of the main battleship turned into a sun-like pattern. The edges of each pair of butterfly wings glowed with a faint red light, continuously shooting out light blades as if they were attacking. If one looked closely, the edges of the butterfly wings were densely packed with cannon barrels. When the dense cannon fire was fired together, it formed something like a "light blade".

The Red Empire's main battleships were in a neat formation. The cannons fired together as if they could tear the universe apart with light beams. The three Universal Civilizations had many types of battleships, and they focused more on technology. The Red Empire's battleships were known for their powerful firepower, sturdy armor, and powerful weapons.

"How long until the reinforcements arrive?" Tarrokov stared at the star map of the battlefield and asked without turning his head.

"The first batch of rapid reaction forces will arrive in about four minutes," the adjutant hastily replied.

Tarrokov nodded. Planet Lighthouse was under attack, and he had already ordered all the troops to return. There were more than three million battleships. As long as they could hold on until they arrived, the size of the fleet would be similar to the Arcane Church's, and the pressure would be reduced by a lot.

If not for him leading the fleet to resist the attacks of the Arcane Church's fleet, they would not even have the chance to wait for reinforcements. He did not have any extra energy to pay attention to the battle of the Beyond Grade As. He could only pray that Black Star and the others would not be defeated so quickly.

"Where are the Fallen Ark troops now?"

"Chief commander, the fleet we sent out is still entangled with the Fallen Ark. They will only arrive in about twenty-two minutes."

Tarrokov nodded. Just as he was about to speak, the radar suddenly sounded.

"Warning! Unknown high-energy source detected! Comparing database … Comparison complete. Target identity: EsGod! "

Tarrokov was shocked. He hurriedly looked up and saw a figure floating in space outside the battlefield.

EsGod!

"Didn't you say twenty minutes? Why is he …" Tarrokov was shocked. He suddenly realized that there were no troops beside EsGod and immediately understood.

This guy had abandoned his fleet and arrived early!

…

EsGod turned around and locked his gaze on the battlefield where the Beyond Grade As were fighting.

He was not satisfied with the speed of the fleet, so he abandoned the fleet and used his teleportation Esper Ability time and time again to arrive at the battlefield on Planet Lighthouse.

Observing the situation on the battlefield, EsGod narrowed his eyes.

"Black Star … where did he go?"

—
